label: Shell (Alpine 3.21)
command: echo "set this preset's verifier command" >&2; exit 2
note: Minimal image with sh only. Replace the command with your verifier.

label: Rust 1.90 (Debian bookworm slim)
note: Fetching crates needs network; vendor dependencies and drop to isolated to verify offline. Build output stays in the container.

label: Node.js 22 (Debian bookworm slim)
command: export HOME=/tmp npm_config_cache=/tmp/npm; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm test
note: npm ci needs network; it writes node_modules into the worktree, so keep it git-ignored.

label: Python 3.13 (Debian bookworm slim)
note: Standard-library unittest needs no network. Raise to network and add pip installs to the command for third-party test dependencies.
